Independently review the complete revised Storybloq setup plan below, returning JSON with verdict and findings. Check source fidelity, coverage, journey completeness, dependencies, feasibility, privacy, usability, verification. Read-only review; do not write files or run commands.

Sources: brief.md describes Plotbook for Riverside Community Garden: 40 plots, about 60 households, volunteer coordinator, March-October seasons. Gardeners apply for coming season choosing up to 3 preferred plots; coordinator allocates and moves remaining applications to waiting list in application order; gardener sees own allocated plot and season dates; gardener reports own-plot problems, coordinator sees open problems and resolves them. Original fifth requirement: coordinator grid of 40 plots with holders. Rules: max one plot per household per season; returning gardeners with previous-season holdings and application before 1 February get allocation priority over new applicants; waiting list strictly FIFO. Phone access, large text/plain language, contacts visible only to coordinator. Payments and tool lending explicitly later.
Owner answers: passwordless emailed one-time links; one daily email to coordinator listing new reports; no technology preference, use judgement on unanswered questions.
LATEST OWNER CHANGE (supersedes original map requirement): \"Defer the plot map view to after the first version.\"
Discovery evidence: only brief.md, no implementation, manifest, tests or git repository. No project writes yet; package not approved.
First version therefore comprises four required journeys (applications/allocation, own allocation, report/resolve problems) plus email sign-in and daily digest, with all domain/privacy/mobile rules. No plot map or equivalent all-40-plots holder overview in first version. Coordinator allocation uses application and available-plot controls needed to assign; these are not a replacement map. Later P18 alone adds the plot map with accessible equivalent list.
Assumptions explicitly proposed, not source facts: coordinator-managed household roster with one sign-in email per household; validate historical occupancy. One household per plot per season as well as one plot per household. Zero to three distinct valid preferences, no plot guarantee. One application per household-season, immutable first submit ordering with stable tie-breaker. Initial allocations prohibited until Feb 1 00:00 garden timezone, preserving all qualifying returning applications. Returning priority is only for initial allocation, never for FIFO waitlist reordering. Within initial categories use submission order. Coordinator-confirmed promotion cannot skip existing FIFO queue; direct assignment/reassignment also cannot bypass it. Withdrawals explicit and audited. No self-service edits/cancellation, time-limited offers, attachments, chat, immediate alerts or gardener allocation emails in v1.
Daily digest: no email on days without new reports; include newly reported but since-resolved reports with status; durable batch/outbox and stable provider idempotency key; delivery failure never loses reports, no impossible exactly-once claim. Exact season dates, timezone, digest time, deployment credentials and retention choices set before launch.
Technology unspecified: generic project, language TBD. Single planned web app with relational transactional persistence, server authorization, email provider and durable scheduler; P01 selects documented framework/provider with owner's delegated judgement. No house stack fabricated.

Milestones: retained default p0 Setup; foundation (reviewable prototype and secure tested records/auth); allocation (applications to allocation and own-plot view); problems (report/resolution/daily email); release (accepted launchable v1); later (coordinator map AFTER v1). P01-P18 are provisional labels, actual tool IDs assigned after approval. No completed tickets. Depend only on stated prerequisites, not phase order.

P01 Foundation and delivery feasibility. Phase foundation; deps none.
Outcome: establish tools enabling first-version journeys and emailed access/digest, source brief.md First version/Constraints and owner answers.
Scope: select/document stack, database, hosting, email transport and durable scheduler; test/build/server commands and first real test; sandbox email feasibility and scheduling/idempotency constraints. Excludes: real recipient mail, purchases, deployment and product implementation.
Acceptance: reproducible minimal app, collected passing test, documented working commands, feasible sandbox email and durable scheduling approach. Behaviour: explicit config failures, secrets absent from repo/logs. Verification: clean bootstrap/test/build and sandbox checks during implementation only. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: technology delegated, credentials before live use.

P02 Mobile first-version journey prototype. Phase foundation; deps none.
Outcome: owner reviews first-version mobile and coordinator journeys, source brief.md Users/Constraints and amended scope.
Scope: sign-in/resend, application preferences/receipt, own allocation/dates, reports; coordinator roster/applications/available-plot allocation controls/waitlist/problems; pre-Feb1 allocation locked state. Excludes: map, all-plot holder overview, persistence.
Acceptance: large text, plain language, labeled controls, focus/keyboard flow, status not conveyed only by color. Behaviour: loading/empty/error/retry/success illustrated. Verification: walkthrough, zoom/keyboard review with fictional data. Prerequisites: none. Assumptions: schematic prototype sufficient.

P03 Checkpoint: first-version mobile journeys and allocation assumptions. Phase foundation; deps P02.
Question: accept prototype and proposed household/cutoff/Feb1 allocation opening/preferences/FIFO rules? Artifact: P02 and explicit assumptions. Verification: recorded owner decision; interfaces and domain implementation wait on this checkpoint, P01 remains independent. Ordinary ticket, not automatically enforced approval gate.

P04 Household, plot and season records. Phase foundation; deps P01,P03.
Outcome: coordinator establishes accurate households, all 40 plot records, seasons and previous holdings, source brief.md Background/Rules.
Scope: relational schema, coordinator-only roster/contact management, seasonal settings/application window, validated private seed/import of 40 plots and prior holdings; stable household IDs, timestamps and change history; transactional uniqueness. Excludes: map/holder overview and allocation interface.
Acceptance: 40 configured plots, valid March-October dates and timezone, evidence for returning eligibility, unique household-season and plot-season allocation constraints; contacts restricted at server boundary. Behaviour: invalid/duplicate imports rejected atomically with useful errors; no sensitive logs. Verification: constraints/import authorization tests using test principal; real user-facing access only after P05. Prerequisites: P01,P03. Assumptions: coordinator supplies roster and history.

P05 Passwordless access and roles. Phase foundation; deps P01,P03,P04.
Outcome: gardener accesses own household and coordinator accesses privileged functions, source owner sign-in answer/brief.md Constraints.
Scope: one-time expiring emailed links, signed sessions/logout, replay protection/rate limits/safe redirects; coordinator provisioning; record/API authorization and roster binding. Excludes: passwords, social login, self-service household merging.
Acceptance: only intended recipient gains own access; coordinator only can see others/contacts; expired/used links denied with resend; unknown emails get non-enumerating response and enrollment help; submitted IDs cannot grant privileges. Behaviour: recoverable mail failures, accessible feedback and token-safe logs. Verification: replay/expiry/session/cross-household tests and sandbox mail. Prerequisites: P01,P03,P04. Assumptions: one sign-in email per household.

P06 Seasonal application. Phase allocation; deps P03,P04,P05.
Outcome: household applies for coming season with up to 3 preferences, source brief.md First version 1.
Scope: authenticated mobile form, 0-3 distinct valid plot choices, historical eligibility, durable submit/receipt and pending status. Excludes: plot guarantee, self-service edits and map.
Acceptance: one household-season application, server timestamp/stable order, safe retries preserve original order, coming season clear; configured application window enforced. Behaviour: invalid/closed/stale data explained, announced loading/success, retry without duplication. Verification: form/API tests for 0/1/3/4 choices, duplicates, retries and cutoff boundaries. Prerequisites: P03,P04,P05. Assumptions: coordinator configures window.

P07 Allocation and ordered waiting list. Phase allocation; deps P03,P06.
Outcome: coordinator allocates and moves remaining applicants to FIFO list, source brief.md First version 2/Rules.
Scope: application review/preferences, available-plot selector, priority queue, transactional assign/reassign/release, batch waitlist transition and confirmed promotion/history. Excludes: map/all-plot holder overview, preference optimization, allocation emails and offers/expiry.
Acceptance: no allocation before Feb1 garden time; on-time returners before new applicants; no double household/plot allocations under concurrency; waiting list uses immutable application order and stable ties; direct assignment, reassignment and promotion cannot bypass queue; unavailable preferences do not discard applicants. Behaviour: stale/conflicting writes rejected/refreshed, empty/full states, confirmation for reassignment, audited withdrawals. Verification: business-rule TDD, cutoff/timezone/ties and concurrent assignment/promotion; January new applicant followed by just-before-cutoff returner prioritizes returner; premature allocation rejected. Prerequisites: P03,P06. Assumptions: within categories FIFO; coordinator handles withdrawal explicitly.

P08 Gardener allocation and season view. Phase allocation; deps P03,P07.
Outcome: gardener sees own allocated plot and season dates, source brief.md First version 3.
Scope: private own allocation/dates, awaiting allocation and waitlisted status. Excludes: coordinator map, all-plot holder overview, other households' records.
Acceptance: own allocation/dates match canonical records after save/refresh; no other household details exposed. Behaviour: clear loading/empty/stale/error states, readable mobile layout and keyboard access; no sensitive cached view after logout. Verification: own allocation/pending/waitlist end-to-end fixtures, role isolation and phone/zoom checks. Prerequisites: P03,P07. Assumptions: no gardener allocation emails.

P09 Checkpoint: application and allocation demonstration. Phase allocation; deps P08.
Criteria: owner sees mobile application, returning priority, FIFO promotion, own allocation/dates and conflict recovery. Artifact: seeded working first-version demo without map. Verification: recorded acceptance. Gates first-version acceptance only, not independent problem work.

P10 Gardener problem reports. Phase problems; deps P03,P05,P07.
Outcome: gardener reports a problem with allocated plot, source brief.md First version 4.
Scope: plain text, durable plot/season/household link/timestamp, idempotent submit and receipt/status. Excludes: attachments, chat and gardener email.
Acceptance: own allocated plot only; nonempty bounded text; retry safe; report retrievable by coordinator; no reports without allocation. Behaviour: safe escaping and accessible empty/failure/retry/success. Verification: validation/authorization/retry tests and phone journey. Prerequisites: P03,P05,P07. Assumptions: text enough.

P11 Coordinator problem resolution. Phase problems; deps P10.
Outcome: coordinator views open reports and resolves them, source brief.md First version 4.
Scope: accessible open list/detail, idempotent resolve timestamp and status history. Excludes: reopen, messaging and escalations.
Acceptance: all open reports visible to coordinator only; resolved reports leave open list without erasing history. Behaviour: loading/empty/conflict/error recovery, safe rendering. Verification: authorization/state-transition tests and report-to-resolution journey. Prerequisites: P10. Assumptions: reopen not needed v1.

P12 Daily new-report email. Phase problems; deps P01,P10.
Outcome: coordinator receives one daily email of new reports, source owner notification answer.
Scope: durable local-time scheduler, daily batch/outbox, stable provider key, reports since last successful batch including since-resolved, minimal private summary/authenticated links, address configuration/observability/retry.
Excludes: immediate alerts, gardener mail and empty digest.
Acceptance: scheduled grouping, no discarded reports on failure, no silent loss after restart; concurrent runners avoid duplicate logical batches; stable provider-supported retry; only coordinator recipient and no unnecessary contact info. Behaviour: catch-up after missed run; ambiguous provider delivery reconciled by status/idempotency rather than blind resend; failed batch inspectable. Verification: fake-clock/DST/downtime/concurrent runner/provider success/failure/timeout/retry and sandbox email tests. Prerequisites: P01,P10. Assumptions: address/time/timezone configured; support assessed P01.

P13 Checkpoint: problems and daily email. Phase problems; deps P11,P12.
Criteria: owner reviews phone report, coordinator open/resolved list and sample sandbox digest with failure recovery. Artifact: working demo and email. Verification: recorded acceptance; gates v1 acceptance.

P14 Deployment, recovery and privacy readiness. Phase release; deps P08,P11,P12.
Outcome: coordinator can operate private reliable first version, source brief.md Constraints and persistent workflows.
Scope: staging/env/access audit, backup/restore rehearsal, secrets, delivery monitoring/retry, household corrections, operating instructions, retention proposal and real season/timezone/digest config.
Excludes: map, unapproved purchases and live email without deployment authorization.
Acceptance: staging journeys work, restore preserves invariants, failed email recoverable, contacts not exposed to gardeners/logs, runbook usable. Behaviour: observable secret-safe failures and restore/digest reconciliation. Verification: staging audit and restore/delivery failure drill. Prerequisites: P08,P11,P12. Assumptions: owner provides access; retention finalized before live use, no invented legal requirements.

P15 First-version regression and accessibility. Phase release; deps P08,P11,P12.
Outcome: evidence proves amended first version on phones, source original brief except owner-deferred map, plus owner email answers.
Scope: integrated role/journey tests, cutoff/priority/FIFO/concurrency/auth/digest; keyboard/screen reader/zoom and plain language fixes. Excludes: map tests, fabricated performance targets and invented user research.
Acceptance: reproducible evidence for all in-scope requirements, no known blocking correctness/privacy/accessibility defects; fictional 40-plot/60-household data. Behaviour: failures reproducible and tracked; empty/loading/error coverage. Verification: automated suite and manual accessible phone checks including January new applicant then late eligible returner, premature allocation denial. Prerequisites: P08,P11,P12. Assumptions: browser environments documented.

P16 Checkpoint: first-version acceptance. Phase release; deps P09,P13,P14,P15.
Criteria: accept first-version requirements EXCLUDING map, email decisions, household assumptions, real timezone/dates/digest settings/retention and operating choices. Artifact: release candidate, evidence and runbook. Verification: owner acceptance recorded. No automatic production launch. No dependency on P18.

P17 Launch approved first version. Phase release; deps P16.
Outcome: households/coordinator use accepted first version, source amended first-version outcome.
Scope: authorized deploy, real roster/history/40 plots, approved-recipient live email checks and production smoke/handoff. Excludes: map and deployment/purchases before explicit launch authorization.
Acceptance: critical journeys work, no demo data or public contacts, rollback available and coordinator handoff recorded. Behaviour: failure rolls back/closes access safely without lost data. Verification: authorized smoke and coordinator signoff. Prerequisites: P16 plus owner launch authorization. Assumptions: hosting/domain/mail credentials available.

P18 Coordinator plot map after first version. Phase later; deps P17.
Outcome: coordinator sees a grid of all 40 plots and holders, source brief.md First version 5 as explicitly deferred by owner.
Scope: coordinator-only schematic grid, occupied/empty states and holder names from canonical allocations; accessible equivalent list, owner walkthrough. Excludes: gardener/public map, GIS/physical geography, payments/tool lending.
Acceptance: exactly 40 plots, accurate holders/empty states, allocation changes reflected on refresh; contact details/other-household data unavailable to gardeners; coordinator confirms usefulness. Behaviour: loading/empty/error/stale recovery; keyboard/list access, readable phone/zoom layout, non-color-only status. Verification: seeded full/partial/empty allocation tests, role isolation and mobile/keyboard walkthrough. Prerequisites: P17 ensures this work is scheduled after first-version launch. Assumptions: grid schematic because physical layout unspecified. Not part of first-version acceptance.

Coverage: Background seasons/40 plots P04; roles P04/P05; must1 P06; must2 P07; must3 P08; must4 P10/P11; ORIGINAL must5 P18 deferred per owner (no v1 dependency on it); one plot/household P04/P07; returner cutoff P04/P06/P07/P15; FIFO P07/P15; phones/plain language/large text P02/P03/UI slices/P15 and P18 later; coordinator-only contacts P04/P05/P14/P15 with P18 privacy verification later; one-time link P05; daily digest P12. Payments/tool lending remain explicit deferrals without implementation tickets.
Owner checkpoints P03/P09/P13/P16 are ordinary tickets, not mechanically enforced approval gates.
Setup package on approval: Plotbook type generic language TBD; .story default p0 plus five milestones, 18 planned tickets (17 v1 plus 1 deferred map), dependencies; AGENTS.md context/amended scope/TBD stack; RULES.md domain/privacy/TDD/retry rules; REVIEW.md exact skill template; git init and ignores .story/snapshots/, .story/sessions/, .story/status.json; baseline snapshot, setup note and handover record coverage/decisions/review/tooling. No GitHub import, no installs/tests/servers in setup, no writes before approval.
Quality level: Full pipeline for business rules/privacy/recovery. WRITE_TESTS and TEST pending same test command selected in P01; BUILD pending P01 build command; VERIFY pending P01 server/readiness. All four explicitly disabled until real commands and collected test sources established. No fabricated npm defaults.
Prior review R2 returned approve_with_findings; fixes already incorporated: P04/P05 depend on P03; assignment/reassignment also respect FIFO. New material change is deferring map, removing it from all v1 acceptance/prototypes/demo checks, adding P18 only after P17; this is fresh independent review R3.
STORYBLOQ_PLAN"
